presentation.summary: A PS5-inspired theme where the selected game's art becomes the room and the chrome is colourless glass.
presentation.description: GameStation dissolves into the cover art: the game you point at fills the whole screen, the chrome is neutral glass that gets out of the way, and a square app-tile row floats up top. Calm, immersive, smooth — every bit of colour comes from the art, never the shell.
presentation.author: unu
